scientific_integrity: The structural bijection and count have a fully written mathematical proof. Standalone Python code independently checks complete relation sets in eight finite test cases. Computations are not described as an infinite proof. The result has received self-review only.
scientific_limitations: Only labelled infallible S4I accessibility preorders over the complete two-level intuitionistic order with both antichain levels of cardinality at least two. It is neither an isomorphism-class census nor a classification of all finite S4I frames. Relation-level exhaustive verification is restricted to at most five worlds; larger exact counts use the proved finite formula. Independent audit has not been performed; an older equivalent order-theoretic formulation may remain unidentified.
title: Top-class normal form and exact census for two-level S4I frames
